conditions_of_stop: ledger transition not attributable to this approved campaign

criteria.acceptance: Existing initial-energy rtol=1e-12, final-energy rtol=1e-10, energy drift <1e-10, residual <1e-10; no general convergence claim.
criteria.oracle: Full-order transient SDOF compared with closed-form motion and initial/final energy; residual assertion.
criteria.oracle_independence: Closed-form scalar SDOF reference; test uses assembled TET4 fixture, therefore assembly is not independently validated.

selection.selection_basis: Single TET4 fixture: 12 total translational DDL, one free dynamic coordinate.
